messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx (502/504) and gateway timeouts observed on /v1/generate across multiple regions. Error rate > 6% for last 5m, P50 latency up ~3x. Paging the on-call rotation. Logs: `502 gateway_error: upstream read timeout`

maria: I'm on it, looking at metrics and the prefix/KV cache dashboards. Will post top hits.

alex: seeing correlated increase in prefix-cache eviction rate and a huge rise in cache miss ratio for kv-shard-07. Possibly a compaction or eviction policy regression.

jen: @maria @alex is there a recent deploy or config change?

maria: Yes — a config push rolled out yesterday 03-10 that tightened in-memory compaction thresholds for the prefix cache (PR #1248). Canary passed but maybe at scale it's causing thrash.

tomo: I'm pulling tail of runtime logs from node pool handling kv-shard-07:```
2026-03-11T22:13:02Z WARN prefix_cache: eviction loop duration=1523ms shard=07 items_evicted=240
2026-03-11T22:13:02Z ERROR kv_client: get_prefix timeout=1200ms key=abc123 shard=07
2026-03-11T22:13:03Z WARN http: upstream request retry 1 status=502
```

maria: that matches. eviction loop is saturating CPU and blocking KV reads -> timeouts upstream -> 5xx. Likely an eviction storm on hot prefixes.

sre-lead: Initial mitigation proposals: 1) Rollback the compaction config from 03-10 (safe, quick). 2) Temporarily raise cache memory limit for affected pools to reduce eviction. 3) Route traffic away from kv-shard-07 using routing weight adjustments. Which can we do fastest?

alex: fastest is to adjust routing weights and bump cache mem limit. Rollback needs CI gating but should be doable.

maria: I'm going to spin a temporary manual override on compaction for shard 07 and increase eviction threshold. Command:```
# on admin node
redwood cache set --shard 07 --compaction-threshold 0.95 --eviction-burst 0.2
```
Applying now.

eng-oncall-bot: change started by maria at 2026-03-11T22:20:11Z - monitoring metrics for 5m.

maria: change applied. Eviction rate down ~70%% within 90s. Cache hit ratio climbing. P50 latency falling.

tomo: I've also bumped route weight away from shard-07 on the routing plane:```
curl -XPOST https://control-plane/route/weights -d '{"kv-shard-07": 0.2, "kv-shard-06": 0.4, "kv-shard-08": 0.4}'
```
Traffic rebalanced.

jen: Customer impact? Any affected tenants or increased error budgets?

customer-success: We have two customers on Dedicated with elevated errors: AcmeCorp and NovaChat — both reported user-facing timeouts. CS has opened support tickets and is notifying them we are mitigating.

sre-lead: Good. Post-mitigation actions: schedule rollback of the 03-10 compaction change to a canary-only rollout until we get deeper validation. Also add better circuit-breaker on eviction loop to prevent CPU saturation.

alex: I'm running a quick canary rollback PR now — if CI green we can revert across clusters. ETA ~25m.

maria: Monitoring for 10m window. So far error rate drop to 0.8%% and latency back near baseline. Will keep watch.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: impact=partial; severity=high; customer_impact=AcmeCorp,NovaChat; actions_taken=[manual compaction override, routing weight shift, canary rollback PR]; responders=[maria,alex,tomo,jen].

jen: Handoff plan: I'm going to hand over to @alex for follow-up and postmortem ownership after we confirm stability for 1hr. alex, can you own the RCA and remediation tasks?

alex: Yep. I'll collect heap dumps, eviction traces, and timeline. Initial hypothesis: compaction threshold regression + uneven prefix hotspot distribution causing massive eviction thrash -> KV client timeouts.

tomo: Captured heap and runtime traces from the affected pod set. Uploading to the incident artifact bucket now: gs://redwood-incidents/1765001234/traces/

maria: Noting temporary mitigations to reverse later: revert cache override and routing weight once fully rolled-out rollback is in place. Document commands we ran in the follow-up.

sre-lead: Postmortem wishlist: timeline, root cause, why canary didn't catch, improved load testing for hot prefix patterns, alert tuning to detect eviction storms earlier, and a runbook entry for manual override. Assign to alex, due EOD+3.

customer-success: We'll send a follow-up summary to AcmeCorp/NovaChat once RCA is available and include timeline and compensation if needed.

alex: A few more logs for the timeline:```
22:13:00 initial spike
22:19:32 config override applied
22:19:40 routing weight change applied
22:21:15 errors back to baseline
```

maria: I'll keep monitoring the dashboards for the next 60m and will post if anything regresses. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

eng-oncall-bot: Handoff complete. Primary responder now alex. If regressions >1%% error within 60m, page SRE secondary.
